@@ -0,0 +1,85 @@
+# Copyright (c) Ansible Project
+# GNU General Public License v3.0+ (see COPYING or https://www.gnu.org/licenses/gpl-3.0.txt)
+
+from ansible.module_utils.facts.network.linux import LinuxNetwork
+
+
+class RouteModule:
+    def __init__(self, responses, ip_path='/usr/sbin/ip'):
+        self.responses = responses
+        self.ip_path = ip_path
+        self.warnings = []
+
+    def get_bin_path(self, name):
+        return self.ip_path if name == 'ip' else None
+
+    def run_command(self, args, **kwargs):
+        return self.responses[tuple(args)]
+
+    def warn(self, message):
+        self.warnings.append(message)
+
+
+def test_local_routes_are_canonical_unique_and_ordered():
+    module = RouteModule({
+        ('/usr/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'type', 'local'):
+            (0, 'local 192.168.1.99/24 dev dummy0 scope host\n'
+                'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n'
+                'local 192.168.1.0/24 dev dummy1 scope host\n'
+                'broadcast 192.168.1.255 dev dummy0 scope link\n'
+                'local 127.0.0.0/8 dev lo scope host\n'
+                'local 192.168.0.1/32 dev dummy0 scope host\n', ''),
+        ('/usr/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'type', 'local'):
+            (0, 'local 2001:0db8:0000::1/64 dev dummy0\n'
+                'local ::1 dev lo proto kernel metric 0 pref medium\n'
+                'local 2001:db8::/64 dev dummy1\n'
+                'anycast fe80:: dev dummy0\n', ''),
+    })
+
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips(module.ip_path) == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.0/8', '127.0.0.1', '192.168.0.1', '192.168.1.0/24'],
+        'ipv6': ['::1', '2001:db8::/64'],
+    }
+
+
+def test_failed_family_keeps_other_local_routes_and_warns():
+    module = RouteModule({
+        ('/usr/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'type', 'local'):
+            (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n', ''),
+        ('/usr/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'type', 'local'):
+            (1, '', 'IPv6 disabled'),
+    })
+
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).get_locally_reachable_ips(module.ip_path) == {
+        'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': [],
+    }
+    assert len(module.warnings) == 1
+    assert 'IPv6' in module.warnings[0]
+
+
+def test_populate_exposes_empty_local_routes_without_ip(monkeypatch):
+    module = RouteModule({}, ip_path=None)
+
+    assert LinuxNetwork(module).populate() == {
+        'locally_reachable_ips': {'ipv4': [], 'ipv6': []},
+    }
+    assert len(module.warnings) == 1
+
+
+def test_populate_includes_local_routes_with_existing_network_facts(monkeypatch):
+    module = RouteModule({
+        ('/usr/sbin/ip', '-4', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'type', 'local'):
+            (0, 'local 127.0.0.1 dev lo scope host\n', ''),
+        ('/usr/sbin/ip', '-6', 'route', 'show', 'table', 'local', 'type', 'local'):
+            (0, 'local ::1 dev lo\n', ''),
+    })
+    monkeypatch.setattr(LinuxNetwork, 'get_default_interfaces', lambda *args, **kwargs: ({}, {}))
+    monkeypatch.setattr(LinuxNetwork, 'get_interfaces_info',
+                        lambda *args: ({'lo': {'device': 'lo'}},
+                                       {'all_ipv4_addresses': [], 'all_ipv6_addresses': []}))
+
+    facts = LinuxNetwork(module).populate()
+
+    assert facts['locally_reachable_ips'] == {'ipv4': ['127.0.0.1'], 'ipv6': ['::1']}
+    assert facts['lo'] == {'device': 'lo'}
+    assert facts['default_ipv4'] == {}
